purpose: external acceptance instrument for the ProgressDesk core delivery
criteria: a checkpoint manifest names the project, the journal sequence it was derived from, the definition references in force, the accepted artifact manifest, the tool, skill and domain version references in force, the task and milestone state and the pending actions
a checkpoint is immutable, a second checkpoint with the same name is refused, and a milestone boundary creates one

the recovery packet names the current task, the accepted baseline, surviving candidate artifacts, completed actions, unresolved effects, failed checks, remaining work and the allowance, and carries no role transcript
the same checkpoint and project produce the same recovery packet
a feature that does not deliver is split, and split again, until it is delivered or unsplittable
a completed phase replays into a deterministic baseline of measured usage, with unmeasured values left unknown
the context a builder receives names the approved specification excerpts the feature asked for, and the milestone gate still judges the whole accepted contract
